'''DecipherCon 1999 Enhanced Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). Decipher scheduled it as SW.20 Enhanced Sealed Deck (ECC+EPP) on Saturday 13 November from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Sunday 14 November from 1 p.m. to 7 p.m.<ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Sunday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive]</ref> It is a different event from the unofficial [[1999 Decipher World Championship ECC Sealed]], which World Championship players held late that night after the awards ceremony,<ref name="tr-d110">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-16-day-one-world-championshipsd110/ day-one-world-championships], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 16 November 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026174240/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-16-day-one-world-championshipsd110/ Internet Archive].</ref> and from the [[DecipherCon 1999 Squadron Members Sealed Deck]] that began about midnight.<ref name="cec-dc2" />

Francis K. Lalumiere wrote that an ECC sealed event drew 176 players, "the biggest tournament in Star Wars CCG history", ahead of the 152 at Origins constructed.<ref name="lal-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 3 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 November 1999 (Saturday heat); 14 November 1999 (Sunday heat)
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[Enhanced Format Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 176 per Lalumiere;<ref name="lal-sat" /> 162<ref name="sat58" /> and "160+"<ref name="sat68" /> per Decipher photo captions

A score sheet is not preserved.

[[Ryan Patterson]] names the staff as himself, [[Alex Alcalde]], "Lars M.", [[Jim Haskell]], [[Josh Clark]] and [[Marcus Certa]], with help during the day from [[James Van Fleet|Jim Van Fleet]] and Winfried Summerfield; [[Jeff Alexander]] joined them after his shift.<ref name="cec-dc1">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon1.html DeciperCon '99 Report No.1], Ryan Patterson, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030053/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="cec-dc2">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon2.html DeciperCon '99 Report No.2], Jeff Alexander, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030058/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon2.html Internet Archive]</ref> Deck building started three hours late, at 2 p.m. Not all 176 command cards had been entered, and after the second pairings the staff found that the software had the event as a Swiss tournament rather than sealed deck. While they fixed it, Certa brought in [[Jeremy Bulloch]] and [[Shannon Baksa]] to sign for the waiting players.<ref name="cec-dc2" /> Forty-eight players were left for the last game, and play ended after 8 p.m., nine hours after it began.<ref name="cec-dc1" /><ref name="cec-dc4">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon4.html DeciperCon '99 Report No.4], Alex Alcalde, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030108/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon4.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Photographs ==
Decipher's Saturday photo album shows the Enhanced Cloud City tournament. One caption places it in the 11th-floor lounge, another in the Cavalier's penthouse lounge.<ref name="sat58">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat58.html DecipherCon 1999 photo sat58], Decipher. Caption: "The 11th floor lounge is a great setting for the 162! player Enhanced Cloud City tournament." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001025165217/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat58.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sat67">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat67.html DecipherCon 1999 photo sat67], Decipher. Caption: "The Enhanced Cloud City tournament draws players to the Cavalier's penthouse lounge." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000616071452/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat67.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Discrepancies ==
* Players: 176 in Lalumiere's Day 3 wrap-up,<ref name="lal-sat" /> 162 in the sat58 photo caption<ref name="sat58" /> and "160+" in the sat68 caption.<ref name="sat68">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat68.html DecipherCon 1999 photo sat68], Decipher. Caption: "Between rounds of the 160+ player Enhanced Cloud City tournament, Marcus Certa sings Broadway show tunes." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000602115340/http://www.decipher.com:80/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat68.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* Players: 176 per Ryan Patterson and Alex Alcalde, as in Lalumiere's count;<ref name="cec-dc1" /><ref name="cec-dc4" /> "over 150" per Jeff Alexander.<ref name="cec-dc2" />
